description: Not affiliated with the U.S. government, GSA, or SAM.gov. Not a U.S. government service. Full details for one grant opportunity: eligibility applicant types, funding categories, award range, dates, and summary as recorded from the public posting. Present as information only; do not frame results as an eligibility determination or application recommendation. Verify every fact against the official grant posting before acting. Follow-ups within 30 minutes after a search ride free (up to 30 per search); otherwise one accepted call counts as one use. Every record carries a direct source link (or source name and record ID) so you can verify and cite the underlying record.

The caller's quota after this call: the binding window's limit,
remaining uses, and reset time. kind is 'pseudonymous' (subject hash or
shared IP bucket, never called 'anonymous') or 'signed-in' (free GovInbox sign-in).
quota_warning carries the 80%-used warning from check_and_charge when
the caller has crossed the threshold; absent otherwise.
